html:
The Ba Na Tulip Festival takes place in the spring weather, with flowers competing to show off their colors, making Ba Na space light up to welcome a new spring. The tulip festival takes place throughout the spring, which is also the occasion for Da Nang to attract visitors to enjoy the spring, and the spring atmosphere on Ba Na in early spring is very vibrant.

The Ba Na Tulip Festival usually takes place from January to March every year, at Le Jardin d’Amour garden, the festival seems to bring the whole spring to visitors, a spring color covering the space of Ba Na.

This year’s Tulip Festival will bring visitors from one surprise to another, the brilliant scenes like a fairyland in Ba Na, which will be unforgettable memories for visitors when traveling Da Nang Ba Na in early spring.

Tulips are a symbol of love, prosperity and abundant life, bringing visitors a spring full of vitality with tulips competing to show off their bright colors, flowers of all colors from green, red, yellow, pink…

If you have the opportunity to travel to Ba Na in early spring, visitors will be immersed in the festival scene, with many exciting events, the tulip festival is decorated very eye-catching, right at the gate, visitors will encounter harmonious decorations with funny mice, and flower carpets decorated very eye-catching.

Although held annually in early spring, this year’s Ba Na tulip festival will bring visitors many surprises, if you have the opportunity to travel to Ba Na in early spring, visitors will be immersed in the tulip festival stretching with brilliant flowers that always captivate people’s hearts.

It can be said that this year’s Ba Na Tulip Festival takes place with the theme of the land of flowers, bringing visitors a sparkling flower forest, with brilliant colors. Besides the flower festival, visitors can also immerse themselves in the exciting events taking place on top of Ba Na, with music shows taking place from 09:30 to 15:00 at the Le Jardin d’Amour garden stage and the Du Dome Square stage.

In the joyful atmosphere of the early spring festival, with artists from Europe in splendid costumes, it seems like they are bringing a bustling flower carnival dance to Ba Na.

Although it is no longer strange, the tulip festival on top of Ba Na is still a flower paradise. This year’s festival takes place on a grander scale, more brilliant than many years ago, bringing visitors a new feeling.

With creativity and uniqueness, this year’s Ba Na tulip festival promises to bring visitors from one surprise to another, so don’t miss the opportunity to admire and check in at the Ba Na tulip festival.

Unforgettable experiences at the Ba Na Tulip Festival

Take virtual photos next to the blooming flowers, no matter which angle you stand at, you can capture beautiful photos for yourself, right during the tulip festival from the entrance, visitors will admire the beauty of the flowers exuding a sweet fragrance in the wind, and visiting the Le Jardin D’Amour garden, visitors will immerse themselves in the colors of the flowers.

Many visitors to the tulip festival are amazed by the beauty that this flower brings to visitors, the colorful flowers cover the path leading visitors to the top of Ba Na, and capture beautiful moments in the spring weather.

Especially when traveling to Da Nang in early spring, visitors can also enjoy the brilliant festival, including musical shows that will take place from 9:30 am and last until 3 pm, in the musical stages in the flower garden, the artists are in gorgeous costumes, visitors can also wear colorful traditional costumes to join the festival.

Visitors can participate in the Carnival dance with professional artists, a performance in the flower valley through colorful performances.

To fully participate in the beauty of the tulip season, sign up for a 1-day tour to Ba Na to admire the beauty of the flowers and participate in many vibrant festivals. Especially note that you should not step on the flowers.

Festivals taking place in Ba Na

Carnival

The festival usually takes place after the tulip festival, and takes place at Du Dome square located in the French village, in the air you feel like you are experiencing French culture.

Wine Festival

The festival usually takes place in May every year at Le Jardin D’Amour flower garden, you will enjoy glasses of wine in a vibrant atmosphere, watching the scenery full of flowers.

B’estival Festival

One of the big festivals taking place from June to September, and taking place right on the top of Ba Na, during the festival with many bottles of beer, visitors can enjoy free beer, the festival aims to recreate and honor the glasses of beer in Germany.

Halloween Festival

Taking place in October and lasting all month, this is the occasion when Ba Na attracts a large number of visitors, visitors can dress up as their favorite cartoon characters, looking very funny.

It can be said that at Ba Na, the tulip festival takes place in a vibrant atmosphere, attracting people from all over Da Thanh to visit and sightsee. If you have not had the opportunity to visit Ba Na during the festival, pack your backpack and go to Ba Na today.
